name: Signature Shiny

components.pose: She stands mid-cast, commanding and composed, her gaze toward the camera, weight shifted, chin lifted, her free hand raised and open as she channels.
components.effects: Necromantic magic gathers around her raised hand - swirling amethyst-and-violet soul energy, thin ribbons of dark smoke, and faint spectral shades rising from the ground around her. A cold violet glow runs along the edge of her weapon's blade. A fine prismatic glitter and a gilded, holographic shimmer play across the metal, the fabric and the magic, every glow edged with a rainbow sheen.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Umbrath, looming in the shadows of the necropolis behind her, obsidian-black and midnight-violet scales, wings like tattered sheets of darkness edged in amethyst light

notes: SHINY variant of the Signature: same scene and pose in a prismatic, gilded colourway with a holographic glitter sheen. Convention: <slug>-scene-signature-shiny.
